file_purpose: Research and evidence profile for Queen Mary University of London MBBS Medicine A100. This file preserves the supplied QMUL production research and implementation mapping; executable rules live in data/universities/queen-mary-a100.json.

manual_review_scope: Scottish Highers plus Advanced Highers in the generic classifier
resit applicants or missing one-sitting metadata
research_scope.notes: The implementation uses Standard 11 evidence-based prediction for supported Home and Overseas school-leaver pools. Historical 3600-scale data is normalised to labelled ApplySmart estimates only, not official QMUL thresholds.

evidence_classification_policy.OFFICIAL: Stated directly by QMUL or UCAS/QMUL course listings in the supplied dossier.
evidence_classification_policy.FOI: Attributable Freedom of Information evidence. Primary evidence, but may not be current-cycle policy.
evidence_classification_policy.ESTIMATE: ApplySmart modelling or derived interpretation. Not an official QMUL rule.
evidence_classification_policy.UNVERIFIED: Third-party or applicant-reported material not suitable for production logic.
evidence_classification_policy.UNAVAILABLE: A source or value identified as missing in the implementation mapping.

route_limited_blockers: A100 contextual numeric rules are not stably published in the supplied dossier.
A100 graduate degree weighting and graduate-specific cut-offs are not published.
Country-specific international academic equivalencies are not fully encoded.
Scottish Higher plus Advanced Higher joint evaluation is official but remains a generic-classifier manual-review boundary.
Resit and one-sitting evidence require applicant-specific metadata.
engine_execution_boundaries: Standard A-level and IB eligibility can be checked where complete GCSE, UCAT, SJT and English evidence is supplied.
Eligible standard Home and Overseas applicants receive clearly labelled ApplySmart predictive estimates based on official methodology and historical admissions statistics.
SJT Band 4 is a deterministic not_eligible outcome.
UCAT below the shared official 2025 4th-decile boundary is a deterministic not_eligible outcome until the annual decile data is refreshed.
Old 3600-scale historical cut-offs are normalised to 2700-scale ApplySmart guidance bands only and must not be presented as official QMUL thresholds.
readiness.summary: Official evidence supports scoped eligibility and Standard 11 ApplySmart predictive interview estimates for supported standard Home and Overseas school-leaver pools.

course_identity.medical_school: Barts and The London School of Medicine and Dentistry

steps: Check academic minimums, UCAT at or above the 4th decile and SJT Bands 1-3.
Rank eligible applicants within Home or Overseas pools using an unpublished weighted score involving UCAT and UCAS Tariff or graduate degree score.
Make post-interview decisions using factors that may include interview score, SJT, UCAS Tariff, UCAT and graduate weighted score.

gcse.minimum_profile: Six GCSEs at 777666 / AAABBB, including Biology, Chemistry, English Language or English Literature, and Mathematics.
gcse.english_language_executable_route: GCSE or IGCSE English Language grade 6/B
manual_review_boundaries: English Literature used without English Language 6/B evidence
International applicant without GCSE or IGCSE route

a_level.subject_rule: Chemistry or Biology plus one further science from Chemistry, Biology, Physics or Mathematics.
a_level.one_sitting_rule: A*AA must be achieved in one sitting over a study period of no longer than two years.

international_baccalaureate.standard: 37 overall with 666 at Higher Level, including Chemistry or Biology plus another science.

scottish.standard: Three Highers at AAA including Chemistry and Biology, plus two Advanced Highers at AA including Chemistry or Biology plus another science.

graduate_a100.reason: Degree weighting and graduate-specific A100 cut-offs are unpublished.

applysmart_predictive_modelling.basis: Official eligibility rules, official interview-selection methodology and official historical admissions statistics exist; exact UCAT/Tariff weighting and current-cycle cut-offs are unpublished.
applysmart_predictive_modelling.display_rule: Predictions must be labelled as ApplySmart estimates, not official QMUL thresholds or guarantees of interview.

remaining_evidence_gaps.production_handling: Disclose as unavailable current-cycle official threshold; use labelled ApplySmart historical-normalised estimates for supported pools.
Do not calculate a QMUL official ranking score; disclose that ApplySmart estimates do not infer the hidden weighting as fact.
Manual review and do not score.
Manual review unless exact country route is encoded and validated.

source_registry.source_name: QMUL admissions statistics for Medicine and Dentistry
supports_rules: 2023-2025 applications, interviews, offers, places and old-scale interview UCAT cut-offs by fee status
No fixed current-scale official threshold is available; ApplySmart estimates remain labelled predictive guidance only.
